mapper.sql: r.id, r.code, r.room_type, r.daily_price_cent, r.note, r.is_active, r.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM boarding_room r WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM boarding_room r ORDER BY r.code
SELECT FROM boarding_room r WHERE r.is_active = 1 ORDER BY r.code
SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM boarding_order o WHERE o.room_id = r.id AND o.status = 'CHECKED_IN') AS in_use_count FROM boarding_room r ORDER BY r.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boarding_room(code, room_type, daily_price_cent, note, is_active, created_at) VALUES(#{code}, #{roomType}, #{dailyPriceCent}, #{note}, #{isActive}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE boarding_room SET is_active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
